name: Honda CB650R
engine: 649 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Honda's Neo Sports Cafe four. Some 2024 bikes have a gear shift arm recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2024 bikes are in recall 25V107 (gear shift arm can come off). Some 2020-2021 bikes are in recall 21V382 (rear reflector).
A-002.reason: Losing the shifter means you can't change gear. The fixes are free.

recalls.what: Gear shift arm fasteners may loosen and the arm may come off, so you can't shift.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the gear shift arm free.

recalls.what: Rear reflector lens may be too dim to meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear reflector free.
